name: viewer-agent-tools
title: Viewer Agent Tools

description: A typed tool catalog that lets an AI agent drive a live Autodesk Viewer: find and search elements into named sets, read properties, isolate, colour, section, frame, measure, screenshot, switch views, and query the property database in a sandboxed worker — with undo snapshots for every display change.
